Hi Rachel — thanks again for joining our session today, and thanks to everyone at Acme for the great Q&A.

Quick bundle of things from our side: 
- Recording + short clips: https://drive.redwood.com/recordings/2028-04-11-acme-webinar (linked; transcript available)
- Attendee CSV (attached): acme_attendees_20280411.csv — includes company, title, email, attendance duration, and Q&A flag
- Prioritized MQLs (attached): prioritized_mql_list_stephanie.csv — flagged hot/warm/cold with suggested SDR owner

Immediate asks: 
1) Can we schedule a 30–45 minute product demo for the two folks who flagged POC interest (listed in the attached MQL CSV)? Rachel, are mornings PST next Tue/Wed easier, or should we pick the week after?
2) Rachel — can you loop in procurement if there are standard contract or security steps we should prep for? We can share a short procurement checklist.
